Package io.mavlink4j.codec

Record Class FrameHeader

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.mavlink4j.codec.FrameHeader
public record FrameHeader(int version, int sequence, SysId system, CompId component, int messageId, int incompatFlags, int compatFlags, boolean signed, SignatureStatus signatureStatus) extends Record
The wire-level facts of one MAVLink frame, decoded but not interpreted. version is 1 or 2 (the magic-byte discriminator, translated to the number everyone actually means); the MAVLink spec itself defines no formula for sequence beyond "wraps at 255, used to detect loss" — drop-rate accounting on top of it is an L3 concern.

incompatFlags/compatFlags are always 0 for a version-1 frame (v1 has no such fields). Per spec, an unrecognized bit in incompatFlags must cause the whole frame to be discarded — the underlying library already enforces this during decode, so a FrameHeader that exists at all has already passed that check.

signed is the raw wire bit ("did the sender claim to sign this"); signatureStatus is the cryptographic-validity dimension SignatureVerifier computed ("did that claim check out") — see SignatureStatus's own javadoc for why they are kept separate rather than collapsed into one boolean.

Thread-safety: Immutable and thread-safe.
